name: Web pony

unlock.how: found in the source of Bashou's site

tips: Every web page is text: press Ctrl+U in your browser to read its HTML source.
`curl -s https://example.com | less` reads a page's source from the terminal, without a browser.
An HTML comment starts with `<!--` and ends with `-->`. The browser hides it, but the source shows it.
personal: Of course I know HTML. I know everything about the web.
